metaDescription: Guides for evaluation participants, reviewers and regulators: submitting predictions, declaring a model, reading an evidence summary.
heading: Help
lead: Short guides to the platform, each one about five minutes to read. They open on GitHub, where the platform’s documentation is kept.

submitting.title: Submitting predictions to an evaluation
submitting.description: The template, the format check, choosing your model card, and what each measure on the result page means.

declaring.title: Declaring a model
declaring.description: The five steps of the model card form, the intended-use statement, and why the risk tier is derived.

evidence.title: Reading an evidence summary
evidence.description: For reviewers, regulators and decision-makers: the seven sections, the gaps, the small groups that are not shown, and what the trace proves.
